description: 'Open console' signed-out redirects to a Clerk-hosted accounts.dev page (dark, purple, no Agent Drive branding, different domain) while the nav 'Sign in' link shows a light, branded in-app page. Same intent, two completely different sign-in screens.
expected: Both routes land on the same branded in-app sign-in.
actual: Redirect URL is dominant-aardvark-1062.accounts.dev/sign-in?redirect_url=.../console; the in-app /sign-in is light and branded.
suggested_fix: Configure the Clerk sign-in URL so protected routes redirect to /sign-in on this domain.

description: 'Open console' sits beside 'Create your workspace' as a near-peer but a signed-out visitor gets no hint (no label like 'Sign in to open console') and no demo; the sign-in page never says a console is behind it.
expected: Button says what will happen for signed-out visitors, or is dropped in favor of nav 'Sign in'.
actual: Click leads to a bare sign-in form with no context.
suggested_fix: Rename to 'Sign in to console' (or hide when signed out); add a one-line context on the sign-in page.

description: The in-app sign-in page shows 'Development mode' under the Clerk card on production.
